# Municipal Ordinance No. 16, Series of 2003

**Ordinance Banning the Cutting of Fruit Trees**

## Summary

This municipal ordinance of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] prohibits the cutting of fruit-bearing trees and large trees that provide benefits to the town. It aims to protect and maintain the health of the environment and prevent potential disasters caused by soil erosion or landslides. Violators will be penalized with fines ranging from Php 2,000.00 to Php 2,500.00 or imprisonment of ten (10) to fifteen (15) days, or both, at the discretion of the court.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Prohibits the cutting of fruit-bearing trees within the jurisdiction of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] to protect and maintain the health of the environment and prevent disasters caused by soil erosion or landslides.
2.  **Section 2.** Prohibits the burning of tree trunks of fruit-bearing trees.
3.  **Section 3.** States that the prohibition of cutting fruit-bearing trees may be waived for properties that may be affected by the power lines of the electric company.
4.  **Section 4.** Penalizes anyone caught cutting fruit-bearing trees with a fine ranging from Two Thousand Pesos (P= 2,000.00) to Two Thousand Five Hundred Pesos (P= 2,500.00) or imprisonment of not less than ten (10) days or not more than fifteen (15) days, or both, at the discretion of the court.
5.  **Section 5.** Designates the Department of Agriculture as the implementing agency, with the assistance of the Pambayang Kinatawan ng Kagawaran ng Likas na Yaman, the Pambansang Alagad ng Batas (PNP), and the Punong Barangay.
6.  **Section 6.** Invalidates any provision inconsistent with this ordinance.
7.  **Section 7.** Mandates the widest dissemination of the ordinance to the residents of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
